title: What's Going on With Meta Stock?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc recaps Meta's earnings reaction and asks what is going on with the stock. Meta beat on both the top and bottom line and gave a reasonably exciting forecast, yet the shares rose 4 to 5% during his members-only live earnings coverage and then fell 6 to 7% the following morning as he recorded. Much of the video recaps the traction of Muse, Meta's personal agent: about 10 million people set it up in roughly a month and a half, around 25% use it daily, and shopping is the top use case so far. He stresses Meta's distribution advantage — its family of apps can put a new agent in front of billions of users quickly — and the early monetisation routes he discussed in the live session, including transactions, subscriptions and business use. He promises a deeper dive into the conference call in the next few days, including management's spending and AI plans. Crucially, he states no valuation, fair value or buy, sell or hold view in this short recap, so it is recorded as commentary only. The call is META — UNCERTAIN, no price stated; his prior Parkevtate META BUY from 18 October stands and there is no stance flip.
